directDependencies.name: tauri-plugin-dialog
directDependencies.purpose: Rust-only native Windows audio file picker that issues an opaque five-minute import capability without returning absolute paths to React
directDependencies.distributionForm: Linked into the desktop executable; no JavaScript dialog package or frontend dialog permission is enabled
directDependencies.alternativesConsidered: Direct Win32 IFileOpenDialog bindings add unsafe platform code; a JavaScript dialog API would expose full paths to the lower-trust WebView; sending selected file bytes over IPC would be unbounded. The official Rust plugin preserves the ADR-016 capability boundary.
